description: Get the Bible verse of the day from Lamplight (https://lamplightverse.com), in the King James Version (KJV) or the World English Bible (WEB). Verses come from a fixed list of daily verses, one per calendar day, and the day turns over at midnight US Eastern. Pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for yesterday, today or tomorrow to match the reader’s own day. The text is the scripture stored on the site, word for word. License: KJV: Public domain outside the United Kingdom; WEB: Dedicated to the public domain. data_updated_at is the date of the verse.

date.description: Day to get, as YYYY-MM-DD. Only yesterday, today or tomorrow (US Eastern) are accepted, so a reader in any time zone can ask for their own day. Default: today, US Eastern.

translation.description: Bible translation: KJV or WEB (World English Bible). Default KJV.

name: verse_of_the_day
title: Bible verse of the day
